content: React 18 StrictMode double-invokes effects in dev to catch missing cleanup. Fix is NOT disabling StrictMode: design the effect so mount->cleanup->mount is idempotent — the useEffect setup must fully create the Three.js scene/renderer/listeners and the cleanup must fully dispose them (renderer.dispose(), geometry/material dispose, cancelAnimationFrame, removeEventListener), so the second mount cleanly rebuilds. A ref guard pattern can also skip duplicate init but the safer, canonical fix is complete teardown symmetry.
